script.title: A WALLET RETURNS
script.scene_zh: 咖啡廳外 · 歸還錢包
script.story_hook: A kind stranger waits with a found wallet.
script.intro_zh: 一位善良的陌生人，帶著撿到的錢包在店外等候。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we return a found wallet. Listen for polite checking questions.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們歸還拾到的錢包。留意有禮貌的核對問句。
script.outro: Wallet home, new friends made. See you soon!
script.outro_zh: 錢包回到家，也交到了新朋友。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each lost-and-found phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀失物歸還的說法。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her twenties with long black hair in a ponytail, wearing an olive green puffer jacket, dark jeans and white sneakers, slim build, holding a brown leather wallet
script.char_b_description: a retired man in his sixties with short gray hair and round glasses, wearing a navy cardigan over a checked shirt, khaki trousers and loafers, slightly stooped, carrying a canvas tote

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, are you Mr. Lin?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ɑɹ ju ˈmɪstɚ lɪn/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，請問您是林先生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's me! Is this about…?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts mi ɪz ðɪs əˈbaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我就是！你打電話來，難道是關於……？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found a wallet this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ə ˈwɑlɪt ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天早上撿到一個錢包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! Thank you, thank you, so much!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋk ju θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 噢！真的非常感謝你！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, first, what color is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl fɜɹst wʌt ˈkʌlɚ ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先確認一下，它是什麼顏色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brown leather, kind of old-looking.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹaʊn ˈlɛðɚ kaɪnd ɑv ˈoldˈlʊkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 棕色皮革，外觀有點舊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Matches so far. Any scratches on the zip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmætʃɪz sɑʊ fɑɹ ˈɛni ˈskɹætʃɪz ɑn ðə zɪp/
dialogue.zh: 應該沒錯。拉鍊上有刮痕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One long scratch, right near the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lɔŋ skɹætʃ ɹaɪt nɪɹ ðə ˈkɔɹnɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有一道長長的刮痕，就在角落附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Can you tell me what's inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kæn ju tɛl mi wʌts ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 很好。你能告訴我裡面有什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, my ID, some cards, cash…
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ ˌaɪˈdi sʌm kɑɹdz kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，身分證、幾張卡、一些現金……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much cash, roughly?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ kæʃ ˈɹʌfli/
dialogue.zh: 現金大概有多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe sixty, sixty-five dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ˈsɪksti sɪksti faɪv ˈdɑlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 大約六十、六十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's sixty-four. Plus a bus card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹs ˈsɪksti fɔɹ plʌz ə bʌs kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 正好六十四，還有一張公車卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it! Oh, I'm so relieved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt oʊ aɪm soʊ ɹɪˈlivd/
dialogue.zh: 就是它！呼，我終於安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose picture is this? May I ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz ˈpɪktʃɚ ɪz ðɪs meɪ aɪ æsk/
dialogue.zh: 這張小照片裡的人是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My grandson, Sam. He's six now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɡrænsʌn sæm hiz sɪks naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我孫子山姆，他今年六歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any keys? I saw two small ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni kiz aɪ sɔ tu smɑl wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 有鑰匙嗎？我看到兩把小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! House and mailbox. Phew.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs haʊs ænd ˈmeɪlbɔks fju/
dialogue.zh: 有！家門和信箱的。天啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take it, Mr. Lin. It's all yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt ˈmɪstɚ lɪn ɪts ɑl jʊɹz/
dialogue.zh: 請拿回去，林先生，這全是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait… this side pocket feels empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðɪs saɪd ˈpɑkɪt filz ˈɛmp ti/
dialogue.zh: 等等……側邊這個口袋感覺空空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was in that pocket?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt wʌz ɪn ðæt ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個口袋裡放了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My library card, a thin blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlaɪˌbɛɹi kɑɹd ə θin blu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我的借書證，一張薄薄的藍卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Did it fall out?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ dɪd ɪt fɔl aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 糟了，該不會掉出來了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I lose that card every month.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ luz ðæt kɑɹd ˈɛvɹi mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 那張小卡我每個月都弄丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on. Is it behind the cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn ɪz ɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 別急。它在現金的後面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You found it! It was hiding!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju faʊnd ɪt ɪt wʌz haɪdɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 你找到了！它躲起來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Folded right up at the very back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊldɪd ɹaɪt ʌp æt ðə ˈvɛɹi bæk/
dialogue.zh: 摺得深深的，就在最底層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What a morning. Thank goodness, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs ˈtɹuːli/
dialogue.zh: 多大的風波。謝天謝地，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you lose it, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹ dɪd ju luz ɪt baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對了，你是在哪裡掉的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the market, near the tomato stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə ˈmɑɹkɪt nɪɹ ðə təˈmeɪtoʊ stænd/
dialogue.zh: 在市集，番茄攤附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I picked it up right by the crosswalk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pɪkt ɪt ʌp ɹaɪt baɪ ðə ˈkɹɔsˌwɔk/
dialogue.zh: 我是在那個斑馬線路邊撿到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I patted my pockets twice on the bus.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈpætɪd maɪ ˈpɑkɪts twaɪs ɑn ðə bʌs/
dialogue.zh: 搭公車時我摸了兩次口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cash or the keys — which first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæʃ ɔɹ ðə kiz wɪtʃ fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 現金和鑰匙，你更擔心哪一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The keys, honestly. The spare's my neighbor's.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kiz ˈɑnəstli ðə spɛɹz maɪ ˈneɪbɚz/
dialogue.zh: 說實話是鑰匙。備用那把在鄰居那兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this card number led me to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs kɑɹd ˈnʌmbɚ lɛd mi tu ju/
dialogue.zh: 所以是卡號把我帶到你這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You called my phone? I almost didn't answer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kɔld maɪ foʊn aɪ ˈɔlmoʊst ˈdɪdənt ˈænsɚ/
dialogue.zh: 你打了我的電話？我差點沒接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unknown number, right? I'd ignore me too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌənnʊn ˈnʌmbɚ ɹaɪt aɪd ɪɡˈnɔɹ mi tu/
dialogue.zh: 來電未顯示嘛，換作我也會掛斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You and this wallet saved my whole week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ænd ðɪs ˈwɑlɪt seɪvd maɪ hoʊl wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 你和這錢包，救回了我的一整週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just promise me one thing instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈpɹɑmɪs mi wʌn θɪŋ ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 那就答應我一件事好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything. Name it, I'll do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪθɪŋ neɪm ɪt aɪl du ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都行，你說，我一定照辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time you find something, pass it on.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm ju faɪnd ˈsʌmθɪŋ pæs ɪt ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 下次你撿到東西，也把這份心意傳下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it? You're serious, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt jʊɹ ˈsɪɹiəs hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣？你是認真的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dead serious. That's the whole deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛd ˈsɪɹiəs ðæts ðə hoʊl diːl/
dialogue.zh: 千真萬確。這就是全部的條件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then coffee is happening. My treat, period.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈkɔfi ɪz ˈhæpənɪŋ maɪ tɹit ˈpɪɹiəd/
dialogue.zh: 那這咖啡我請定了。就這樣，別推辭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, you win. One small latte.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ju wɪn wʌn smɑl ˈlɑteɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，你贏了。一杯小拿鐵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two lattes, plus those cinnamon buns you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈlɑteɪz plʌz ðoʊz ˈsɪnəmən bʌnz ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 兩杯拿鐵，再加你愛的那種肉桂捲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you know about the buns?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju noʊ əˈbaʊt ðə bʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼知道我愛吃肉桂捲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're holding a bakery bag, funny enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈhoʊldɪŋ ə ˈbeɪkəɹi bæɡ ˈfʌni ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 你手上正提著麵包袋，巧合吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Okay, that's fair. Lead the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ oʊˈkeɪ ðæts fɛɹ liːd ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！說得也對。請帶路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After you. And thank you, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftɚ ju ænd θæŋk ju ˈtɹuːli/
dialogue.zh: 你先請。真的，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your grandson's picture made today easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈɡrænsʌnz ˈpɪktʃɚ meɪd təˈdeɪ ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 你孫子的照片，讓今天變得很輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tell him. He collects heroes, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛl hɪm hiː kəˈlɛkts ˈhɪɹoʊz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我會告訴他。他最喜歡「收集」英雄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him heroes zip their wallets shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ˈhɪɹoʊz zɪp ðɛɹ ˈwɑlɪts ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 告訴他，英雄都會把錢包拉鍊拉好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. What's your name, hero-to-be?
dialogue.phonetic: /diːl wʌts jʊɹ neɪm ˈhɪɹoʊ tə bi/
dialogue.zh: 說定了。你的名字是，準英雄？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ruth. And here's my number, just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹuːθ ænd hɪɹz maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 露絲。這是我的電話，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saved. Sunday dumplings at my place, Ruth?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪvd ˈsʌndeɪ ˈdʌmplɪŋz æt maɪ pleɪs ɹuːθ/
dialogue.zh: 存好了。露絲，週日來我家吃餃子？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring the tea. See you Sunday!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bɹɪŋ ðə ti siː ju ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我帶茶來。週日見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's settled, then. Ten in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈsɛtəld ðɛn tɛn ɪn ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那就說定了。上午十點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten sharp. Bye for now, Mr. Lin!
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ʃɑɹp baɪ fɔɹ naʊ ˈmɪstɚ lɪn/
dialogue.zh: 十點整。先走了，林先生，拜拜！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, Ruth! Best morning in a long time.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ɹuːθ bɛst ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ɪn ə lɔŋ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 拜拜，露絲！好久沒這麼開心的早晨了。

script.youtube_title_en: "Then Coffee Is Happening" — Returning a Lost Wallet
script.youtube_description:
60句歸還錢包聽力練習：在街頭撿到錢包，該怎麼確認失主、完整歸還，又怎麼回應對方的道謝與請客？

這一集跟著撿到錢包的露絲，在咖啡廳外等到失主林先生。從顏色、刮痕、現金數目一路核對到身分證姓名，中間還有一張失而復得的借書證小虛驚，最後一杯咖啡變成週日餃子的約定。

你會聽到：
- 核對身分的禮貌問句：「Can you tell me what's inside?」
- 描述物品與數目的說法：「Brown leather, kind of old-looking.」
- 婉拒謝禮、轉移謝意的地道應對：「That's the whole deal.」
- 道謝與請客的自然閒聊：「My treat, period.」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of wallet-return listening practice: a kind finder waits outside a café to hand a lost wallet back to its owner, after a careful round of checking questions about color, scratches, cash, keys and an ID name.

You will hear how to confirm someone is the real owner, talk through where the wallet was lost, politely refuse a reward, and turn a thank-you into fresh coffee and a Sunday dinner invitation. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

這一集帶大家走進咖啡廳門外，跟著撿到錢包的露絲，一步一步核對顏色、刮痕與現金數目，把錢包完整歸還，也收穫了一段溫暖的友誼。

script.thumbnail_action: handing over a brown leather wallet
